name: Wefunder

sources.title: Eligibility & requirements — US-registered entities only (C-Corp, LLC, or Public Benefit Corp); restricted industries; Reg CF use-of-proceeds rule
Getting started (search-indexed) — start a raise at wefunder.com/raise; review before going live; Private Rounds are free for founders
Pricing (search-indexed) — Private Rounds free for founders; invited investors pay no fees; Wefunder-introduced investors pay 5% management fees + 10% carry

conditions: Creating a raise is free for founders, but this is regulated equity crowdfunding — the 'listing' is a live securities offering requiring SEC Form C filing, not a directory entry
Only appropriate if the product is actually raising investment; the batch's 'signup' route is for investors — founders go to wefunder.com/raise
Only US-registered entities (C-Corp, LLC, Public Benefit Corp); ~half of Reg CF proceeds must be spent in the US
requirements: US legal entity (Delaware C-Corp typical) with EIN; foreign founders must notarize a Form C Power of Attorney
Restricted industries excluded (cannabis, adult, gambling, pawn brokers, others per banking partners)
Accurate campaign sections (Part 1–3) that generate the Form C filed with the SEC — errors delay launch
Wefunder recommends launching only when investors are already willing to invest; 'Warmup' mode exists to build followers first
preparation: US entity details: legal name, EIN, formation docs
Investment terms, fundraise goal, pitch deck
Decide Community Round (Reg CF, anyone can invest, $5M/yr cap) vs Private Round (Reg D, accredited investors only, no public solicitation by default)
Founder identity verification documents; for foreign founders a notarized POA
workflow: Go to wefunder.com/raise and sign up the company (use a browser — site 403s automated fetches)
Fill campaign sections Parts 1–3 — this data generates the SEC Form C
Wefunder team reviews the submission and contacts you for next steps
Optionally run a Warmup campaign to collect followers before going live
Push live; a Community Round page becomes publicly visible at wefunder.com/<company>
watchFor: This is a securities offering — every statement on the page is a regulated disclosure; no marketing hyperbole
A live Reg CF page is public and indexable, but it exists to take investments — don't launch one just for exposure
Reg D 506(b) private rounds cannot be publicly advertised at all
Batch signup URL (wefunder.com/users/sign_up) is the investor account flow, not the founder raise flow
countsAsLive: A public raise page exists at wefunder.com/<company> accepting investments (Community Round) — or for Warmup, a follower page is live
unknowns: Review turnaround before a raise can go live
Whether profile pages for non-raising companies can exist publicly
Current fee split for Reg CF community rounds (only Private Round pricing was verified)
